reading.title: Scorpio Moon and Pluto's Slow Turn
overview: The Sun at 18° Libra in fall and the Moon at 1° Scorpio in fall set a tone of strained relations and hidden pressures, with Mercury and retrograde Venus also in Scorpio. Neptune at 3° Aries retrograde sextile Pluto at 3° Aquarius retrograde, Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde trine Pluto, and Mars at 8° Leo sextile Uranus describe gradual shifts in collective beliefs alongside sudden technical disruptions and attritional blockades.

Mundane tradition links these configurations to alliances tested by force and resources, with Mars trine Saturn at 11° Aries retrograde pointing to prolonged standoffs rather than decisive breakthroughs. The last new moon at Virgo 18° falls in the fourth house for the United States and the first house for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, framing domestic security and national identity as focal points.

Transits within 2° to national angles include Saturn trine the United States ascendant and Neptune opposition its midheaven, Neptune square Russia's Sun, Pluto conjunct Ukraine's Saturn, and Pluto conjunct China's Moon and ascendant.

nations.reading: Transiting Saturn trines the Sibly ascendant while Neptune opposes the midheaven and squares natal Venus; Jupiter sextiles natal Mars. These contacts coincide with reporting on energy-ceasefire proposals and Red Sea responses, though the lore does not extend to specific policy outcomes.

Neptune squares natal Sun, Jupiter trines the midheaven and squares Pluto and Venus, while Saturn trines Mercury and Uranus trines Saturn. The placements align with coverage of diesel supplies and Ukrainian strikes on energy targets without claiming predictive power.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Saturn squares natal Uranus. Reporting on air-raid alarms and drone production increases sits alongside these transits, yet the records show no reliable link beyond chance.
Saturn conjoins natal Sun and Mars sextiles natal Moon, with the Sun conjoining natal Pluto. These occur near mentions of possible strikes on Iranian territory and Hormuz activity.

reading.lore_and_intel: Aspects such as Venus square Mars, Mars opposition Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto and Mars sextile Uranus overlap with reporting on tanker strikes, energy infrastructure attacks and ceasefire announcements, particularly where z-scores exceed 3.4; Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune touch on belief shifts and technical incidents in the same briefings. No overlap appears with the fair-test results for air-raid alarms or personnel losses, which remain indistinguishable from chance.

watch.note: Pluto stations direct; watch for shifts in long-term power structures already highlighted by current Pluto aspects.
Sun enters Scorpio; note the change of sign for the Libra Sun now in fall.
Full Moon at Taurus 3°; observe any developments tied to the prior Virgo new moon houses.

reading.the_test: Records over 1654–3870 days show Mars afflictions, Mars retrograde and full moons produce changes in Ukrainian air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts and claimed Russian losses no better than chance, with differences of -1% to +35% and all p-values above 0.05 after correction. The same holds for Mars retrograde versus personnel losses.
